summary_1line: Sumantra recounts a prophecy that sage Rishyasringa will be brought from the forest and his presence will lead to events enabling King Dasharatha to obtain a son.

image_candidates.scene_text: The minister Sumantra stands in private audience before King Dasharatha, recounting the ancient prophecy of the forest sage Rishyasringa.
The young ascetic Rishyasringa lives deep in the forest beside his father Vibhandaka, performing fire sacrifice and unaware of the outside world.
King Lomapada consults anxious brahmins during a devastating drought, asking how he might atone for the sins that brought it.
